name: issue-117-projected-off-target-immovable
description: Issue #117: PROJECTED_OFF_TARGET must measure each class against the immovable-adjusted, scaled resting point Step 5 sizes toward — immovable + (target - immovable) * scale — not target * scale. A frozen (within-tolerance) fixed-income sleeve plus a locked IRA pushes scale to 0.4. US_LARGE_CAP is underweight with a locked position BELOW target (immovable 15k < target 40k): it settles at its reachable 0.25 and must NOT flag. DEVELOPED_INTL is overweight with a locked position ABOVE target (immovable 25k > target 10k): it is genuinely stuck and MUST still flag. Pre-fix, target * scale spuriously flagged US_LARGE_CAP too. Uses VOO (a leaf US_LARGE_CAP), not VTI/US_TOTAL_MARKET, because US_TOTAL_MARKET auto-splits into cap children on schema load (#127).
